points.title: 音乐启蒙
points.description: 迈克尔·杰克逊1958年8月29日出生于印第安纳州加里市的一个非裔美国人家庭。他的父亲约瑟夫·杰克逊曾是钢厂工人，后来成为孩子们的经纪人。从5岁开始，迈克尔和他的四个哥哥组成了杰克逊五人组(Jackson 5)，在当地俱乐部和才艺表演中演出。1963年，他们与当地唱片公司Steeltown Records签约，录制了第一首单曲《Big Boy》。1966年，他们赢得了著名的阿波罗剧院业余比赛，这为他们赢得了全国关注。这段时期奠定了迈克尔作为表演者的基础，展示了他惊人的舞台天赋和音乐才能。
points.descriptionEn: Michael Jackson was born on August 29, 1958, in Gary, Indiana, to an African American family. His father, Joseph Jackson, was a steel mill worker who later became the children's manager. From age 5, Michael and his four older brothers formed the Jackson 5, performing at local clubs and talent shows. In 1963, they signed with local record label Steeltown Records and recorded their first single 'Big Boy.' In 1966, they won the famous Amateur Night at the Apollo Theater competition, gaining national attention. This period laid the foundation for Michael's career as a performer, showcasing his extraordinary stage presence and musical talent.

points.title: 童星崛起
points.description: 1969年，杰克逊五人组与Motown唱片公司签约，移居洛杉矶。他们的前四首单曲连续登上Billboard Hot 100榜首，创造了流行音乐史上的纪录。迈克尔作为主唱和领舞迅速成为乐队焦点。1971年，他开始个人发展，发行首张个人专辑《Got to Be There》。1972年，他主演了电影《The Jackson 5 in American Bandstand》和《The Jackson 5 Go Hollywood》。这段时期，迈克尔发展出标志性的舞蹈动作，如'机器人舞'和'月球漫步'的雏形。尽管童星生涯带来了巨大成功，但也剥夺了他正常的童年，这对他后来的心理发展产生了深远影响。
points.descriptionEn: In 1969, the Jackson 5 signed with Motown Records and moved to Los Angeles. Their first four singles consecutively topped the Billboard Hot 100, creating a record in pop music history. Michael quickly emerged as the group's focal point as lead singer and dancer. In 1971, he began his solo career with the album 'Got to Be There.' In 1972, he starred in films 'The Jackson 5 in American Bandstand' and 'The Jackson 5 Go Hollywood.' During this period, Michael developed signature dance moves like the robot and early versions of his moonwalk. Despite the tremendous success, his childhood was severely restricted, which profoundly impacted his psychological development later in life.

points.title: 转型成熟
points.description: 1979年，迈克尔发行专辑《Off the Wall》，由传奇制作人昆西·琼斯制作，标志着他艺术上的成熟。专辑产生了多首热门单曲，包括《Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough》和《Rock with You》。1982年，他发行了划时代的专辑《Thriller》，这张专辑至今仍是全球最畅销的专辑，产生了七首Top 10单曲。1983年，他在Motown 25周年电视特别节目中表演了标志性的'月球漫步'，这一瞬间成为流行文化史上的经典。1984年，他出演电影《紫雨》，并为其创作了原声带。这一时期，迈克尔从童星成功转型为全球流行音乐偶像，他的音乐风格融合了流行、摇滚、R&B和放克，舞台表演极具创新性，彻底改变了音乐录影带的艺术形式。
points.descriptionEn: In 1979, Michael released 'Off the Wall,' produced by legendary producer Quincy Jones, marking his artistic maturity. The album produced multiple hit singles including 'Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough' and 'Rock with You.' In 1982, he released the groundbreaking album 'Thriller,' which remains the best-selling album of all time globally, producing seven Top 10 singles. In 1983, he performed his iconic moonwalk during the Motown 25th anniversary television special, a moment that became legendary in pop culture history. In 1984, he starred in the film 'Purple Rain' and created its soundtrack. During this period, Michael successfully transitioned from child star to global pop icon, fusing pop, rock, R&B, and funk in his music, with innovative stage performances that revolutionized the art form of music videos.

points.title: 全球巨星
points.description: 1985年，迈克尔参与创作了慈善单曲《We Are the World》，为非洲饥荒筹集数百万美元，展示了他作为人道主义者的另一面。1987年，他发行专辑《Bad》，产生了五首美国冠军单曲。这一时期，他购买了位于加州的梦幻庄园(Neverland Ranch)，将其打造成一个充满奇思妙想的私人游乐园和慈善中心。1988年，他出版了自传《Moonwalk》，并主演了电影《月球漫步者》。他的演唱会门票屡创纪录，1987-1989年的'Bad'世界巡演吸引了超过400万观众。迈克尔成为全球文化现象，他的时尚风格、舞蹈动作和音乐影响了整整一代人。然而，随着名声的扩大，他的个人生活也开始受到媒体前所未有的关注。
points.descriptionEn: In 1985, Michael co-wrote the charity single 'We Are the World,' raising millions for African famine relief, showcasing his humanitarian side. In 1987, he released 'Bad,' which produced five US number-one singles. During this period, he purchased Neverland Ranch in California, transforming it into a private amusement park and charity center. In 1988, he published his autobiography 'Moonwalk' and starred in the film 'Moonwalker.' His concert tickets set records, with the 1987-1989 'Bad' world tour attracting over 4 million fans. Michael became a global cultural phenomenon, with his fashion, dance moves, and music influencing an entire generation. However, as his fame grew, his personal life began to receive unprecedented media attention.

points.title: 争议与挑战
points.description: 1991年，迈克尔与索尼音乐公司签订了价值6亿美元的破纪录合约。1995年，他发行了双碟专辑《HIStory: Past, Present and Future, Book I》，融合了他的经典作品和新歌。1996年，他与丽莎·玛丽·普雷斯利结婚，1997年离婚。1996-1999年，他进行了'HIStory'世界巡演。1993年，他首次面临儿童性侵指控，最终以2300万美元达成庭外和解。2001年，他在纽约举行慈善演唱会，纪念9/11事件。2002年，他第三次结婚，与黛比·罗生生下第二个孩子。2003年，他接受英国记者马丁·巴舍尔的采访，节目中他承认与同床共枕的儿童'很奇怪'，引发公众强烈反响。这一时期，尽管音乐上仍有成就，但迈克尔的名誉受到严重损害，健康状况也日益恶化。
points.descriptionEn: In 1991, Michael signed a record-breaking $600 million contract with Sony Music. In 1995, he released the double album 'HIStory: Past, Present and Future, Book I,' combining his greatest hits with new material. In 1996, he married Lisa Marie Presley, divorcing in 1997. From 1996-1999, he embarked on the 'HIStory' world tour. In 1993, he first faced allegations of child molestation, eventually settling out of court for $23 million. In 2001, he held a charity concert in New York to commemorate the 9/11 attacks. In 2002, he married for the third time to Debbie Rowe, with whom he had two children. In 2003, he gave an interview to British journalist Martin Bashir, where he admitted that sleeping with children was 'weird,' causing public outrage. During this period, despite musical achievements, Michael's reputation suffered severely, and his health deteriorated.

points.title: 最后岁月
points.description: 2005年，迈克尔面临第二次儿童性侵指控的审判，最终被所有指控宣告无罪。审判期间，他的健康状况进一步恶化，据报道他依赖止痛药。2006年，他移居巴林，后返回美国。2007年，他与一家唱片公司签约计划新专辑，但项目未能完成。2008年，他宣布将在伦敦举行50场告别演唱会，这是他自1997年以来首次巡演。2009年6月25日，在演唱会排练期间，迈克尔因处方药物过量导致心脏骤停去世，享年50岁。他的突然死亡引发了全球哀悼，数亿人观看了他的公众葬礼。他的遗产包括14首美国冠军单曲，13项格莱美奖，以及被吉尼斯世界纪录认证为'史上最成功的艺术家'。他的音乐和影响力在他去世后持续存在，成为流行文化中最持久的偶像之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 2005, Michael faced a second trial on child molestation charges, ultimately being acquitted of all charges. During the trial, his health further deteriorated, with reports of his dependence on painkillers. In 2006, he moved to Bahrain, later returning to the US. In 2007, he signed with a record label for a new album, but the project was never completed. In 2008, he announced 50 farewell concerts in London, his first tour since 1997. On June 25, 2009, during rehearsals for the concerts, Michael died of cardiac arrest caused by a propofol overdose, aged 50. His sudden death triggered global mourning, with hundreds of millions watching his public memorial service. His legacy includes 14 US number-one singles, 13 Grammy Awards, and being certified by Guinness World Records as the 'Most Successful Entertainer of All Time.' His music and influence continue to endure after his death, making him one of the most enduring icons in popular culture.

appraisal.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊被公认为流行音乐之王，他革新了音乐录影带的艺术形式，将其提升为叙事性短片，并以融合多种风格的音乐跨越种族与文化界限，成为20世纪最重要的文化偶像之一。不过也有研究者指出，他的个人生活争议不断，两次儿童性侵指控、频繁改变外貌以及梦幻庄园的生活方式都严重损害了他的名誉，其财务与健康问题也削弱了公众形象。正因如此，他既是天才艺术家，也是悲剧人物，这种双重性使他的遗产至今仍是持续讨论的对象。
appraisal.en: Michael Jackson is widely recognized as the King of Pop, who revolutionized the music video by elevating it to narrative short film and whose genre-blending music crossed racial and cultural boundaries, making him one of the most significant cultural icons of the 20th century. Yet researchers also point to a life shadowed by controversy: two child molestation allegations, frequent changes to his appearance, and the Neverland Ranch lifestyle severely damaged his reputation, while financial and health problems undermined his public image. He thus remains both a genius artist and a tragic figure, a duality that keeps his legacy a subject of ongoing debate.

supporter.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊被支持者誉为流行音乐之王，他的艺术成就和影响力无人能及。他不仅革新了音乐录影带的艺术形式，将其提升为叙事性短片，还通过慈善事业和人道主义工作展现了社会责任感。他的音乐融合多种风格，跨越种族和文化界限，成为全球文化交流的桥梁。尽管面临个人争议，但他的艺术遗产和对流行文化的持久影响使他成为20世纪最重要的文化偶像之一，激励了无数后来的艺术家。
supporter.en: Michael Jackson is revered by his supporters as the King of Pop, whose artistic achievements and influence remain unparalleled. He revolutionized the art form of music videos, elevating them to narrative short films, and demonstrated social responsibility through his humanitarian work. His music, blending multiple styles and transcending racial and cultural boundaries, served as a bridge for global cultural exchange. Despite personal controversies, his artistic legacy and enduring impact on popular culture make him one of the most significant cultural icons of the 20th century, inspiring countless subsequent artists.

critic.zh: 批评者指出迈克尔·杰克逊的个人生活充满争议，特别是两次儿童性侵指控对他的名誉造成严重损害。他们质疑他频繁改变外貌特征的决定，包括多次整形手术和肤色变白，认为这反映了他对自我身份的认同危机。此外，他梦幻庄园的生活方式被批评为不切实际和脱离现实。批评者认为，尽管他的音乐才华不可否认，但他的个人行为和决策失误，包括财务管理和健康问题，削弱了他的公众形象和遗产。
critic.en: Critics point out that Michael Jackson's personal life was fraught with controversy, particularly the two allegations of child molestation that severely damaged his reputation. They question his decision to frequently alter his appearance, including multiple plastic surgeries and skin color changes, suggesting a crisis of self-identity. Additionally, his lifestyle at Neverland Ranch was criticized as unrealistic and detached from reality. Critics argue that while his musical talent is undeniable, his personal behavior and poor decisions, including financial management and health issues, undermined his public image and legacy.

objective.zh: 从历史和流行文化视角看，迈克尔·杰克逊已成为一个复杂的文化符号，代表着流行音乐的黄金时代。他的职业生涯反映了20世纪末全球化的兴起和媒体力量的扩张。他的音乐和表演风格影响了整整一代艺术家，从流行到嘻哈领域。尽管他的个人生活充满争议，但他的艺术成就和文化遗产不容忽视。在流行文化中，他既是天才艺术家，也是悲剧人物，这种双重性使他成为持续讨论和研究的对象，确保了他的遗产在几十年后仍然相关。
objective.en: From a historical and pop culture perspective, Michael Jackson has become a complex cultural symbol representing the golden age of pop music. His career reflects the rise of globalization and the expansion of media power in the late 20th century. His musical and performance style influenced generations of artists across genres from pop to hip-hop. Despite his controversial personal life, his artistic achievements and cultural legacy cannot be overlooked. In popular culture, he is both a genius artist and a tragic figure, this duality ensuring his legacy remains relevant decades later and a subject of continuous discussion and research.

self.zh: 我想用我的音乐和舞蹈给世界带来欢乐，治愈人们的心灵。
self.en: I want to use my music and dance to bring joy to the world and heal people's hearts.
